text: Do not begin writes in ScalaFIM until companion bead bd-01KYT2FD73TC4X1SC10HB5NCW3 is unblocked: current surface baseline fails before mesh4s integration with 88 image4s/locus compile errors, and existing dirty work overlaps build.sbt plus TriangleMesh, MeshTopology, SurfaceData, SurfaceLocusDomain, and tests.
